results.snippet:
The Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs commissioned SEO Amsterdam Economics (SEO) to assess the potential economic impact of the Free Trade Agreement (FTA) between the European Union and the Republic of India. SEO estimates a small but positive increase of real income for the Netherlands as a result of the FTA.
